notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only credential logging review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review sensitive session data in logs
vectors.rationale: Session credentials and logging fields require a source-visible exposure-control review.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: A sensitive session credential may reach an application log field without redaction or removal.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies the log operation and source-visible sensitive value exposure.

limitations: Static review cannot prove downstream log retention or access controls.
